trap.label: processo (passiva em sequência)
trap.wrong: First, the beans harvest. Then they ferment. Next they dry by the sun.
trap.right: First, the beans are harvested. Then they are fermented. Next they are dried by the sun.
trap.why: Em português “as sementes colhem-se” e “fermentam” soam ativos. Em inglês, processos usam passiva (are + pp); ferment no ativo muda o sentido.

mcq.q: Next, they ___ dried by the sun.

fix.right: The beans are dried in the sun.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Workers harvest the beans.”
rewrite.answer: The beans are harvested by workers.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “They roast the nuts.”
Une com Then: “Beans are dried. Beans are packed.”
rewrite.answer: The beans are dried. Then they are packed.
